final: WITH type_counts AS (SELECT t.tradekind AS trader_type, COUNT(*) AS behavior_count FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS r ON a.translink = r.transreg JOIN trader AS t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY t.tradekind), shares AS (SELECT trader_type, behavior_count, 1.0 * behavior_count / SUM(behavior_count) OVER () AS share FROM type_counts), compared AS (SELECT trader_type, behavior_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT trader_type, behavior_count, share, share - average_share AS share_minus_average FROM compared WHERE share > average_share
